label: Machines and architecture
text: CS.O.A2.4 Machines and architecture — memory hierarchy, pipelines, parallel speed-up. Amdahl's law bounds speed-up by 1/((1−p) + p/s) for a fixed workload whose fraction p is parallelisable by a factor s.

warrant.standard: proof of bound on a stated model; benchmark with stated variance
warrant.defeaters: model mismatch with hardware, unrepresentative input
